title: Craigdarroch Castle Pedicab Tour
includes: 3 hour sightseeing tour in a pedicab
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Non-motorized wheelchairs can be carried on board and assistance is given boarding and dismounting
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
policies: Please put your desired departure time in the "special requirements field" when you book
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience one of Victoria’s most iconic landmarks the most memorable way: by pedicab. This guided tour takes you through beautiful heritage streets to Craigdarroch Castle, with a special stop at Government House, the Lieutenant Governor’s grounds, a peaceful garden setting that tour buses can’t access. Along the way, your professional guide shares the stories behind Victoria’s grand architecture, local history, and the people who shaped the city. Then step into Craigdarroch Castle and admire its stunning woodwork, stained glass, and Victorian era details as the past comes alive.
